verdict.rationale: Zero's GitHub page states it 'does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way,' and self-hosting support (Docker compose files, self-hosting docs) lets AI-native users run their own instance with no vendor telemetry at all. However there is no explicit telemetry settings/opt-out toggle documented, no privacy policy detail, and no independent verification of the no-tracking claim. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry opt-out control/setting, detailed privacy policy, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the no-tracking claim.
